name: Storyblocks
original_description: Search Storyblocks stock videos, music, sound effects, and images in ChatGPT. Preview results in an interactive media carousel, inspect asset metadata and available formats, find similar content, explore categories and related search terms, and refine searches with catalog counts. Download selected assets when explicitly requested. Requires Storyblocks authentication; downloads depend on account entitlements. Each successful download-link request licenses the asset, records a download, and consumes plan quota, including repeat requests.
description_scope: ChatGPT詳細画面の提供元の英語説明。
summary_ja: ストック動画・音楽・効果音・画像を検索して確認する。
limitations_ja: Storyblocksの認証が必要。ダウンロードリンクの発行に成功するたび、再取得も含めライセンス・ダウンロード記録とプラン枠の消費が発生すると説明。
